question: List the names and prices of the 5 cheapest products.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 5

question: List the names of all customers from Japan.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country = 'Japan'

question: Which orders have a total above $1500? Show the order id and total.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 1500

question: Show the payment id and amount for bank transfer payments over $600.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT id, amount FROM payments WHERE method = 'bank_transfer' AND amount > 600

question: List the 5 products with the highest unit cost, showing name and cost.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT name, cost FROM products ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many orders have been delivered?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'

question: What is the average product price in each category?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: How many reviews has each star rating received?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) FROM reviews GROUP BY rating

question: What is the total amount paid through each payment method?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT method, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM payments GROUP BY method

question: Which country has the most customers?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT country FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is our total revenue?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'

question: Which product category earned the least revenue?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.line_total) ASC LIMIT 1

question: What are the names of the products in the Books category?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Books'

question: For orders over $1500, show each order id with the name of the customer who placed it.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.id, cu.name FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.total_amount > 1500

question: Which customers paid with a gift card for an order over $300? Show distinct customer names.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT cu.name FROM payments pay JOIN orders o ON o.id = pay.order_id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE pay.method = 'gift_card' AND pay.amount > 300

question: List the products in order 2404 with their quantities.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.name, oi.quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = 2404

question: Show the names of Electronics products that have received a 1-star review, without duplicates.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE r.rating = 1 AND c.name = 'Electronics'

question: Which customers from Germany have placed more than 5 orders? Show the name and number of orders.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT cu.name, COUNT(*) FROM customers cu JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.id WHERE cu.country = 'Germany' GROUP BY cu.id, cu.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

question: How many orders were placed in December 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-12-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: What was the total revenue in 2024?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' AND status != 'cancelled'

question: How many customers signed up in the first half of 2024?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < '2024-07-01'

question: What is the average number of days it took to ship orders placed in 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(shipped_date) - julianday(order_date)), 2) FROM orders WHERE shipped_date IS NOT NULL AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: How many orders were placed in each quarter of 2024?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 AS q, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY q

question: How many days ago was the most recent order placed?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT CAST(julianday('2025-12-31') - julianday(MAX(order_date)) AS INTEGER) FROM orders

question: How many orders were placed last quarter?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND order_date < '2025-10-01'
